name: ITGmania
description:
ITGmania is an open-source rhythm game engine forked from StepMania 5.1, tailored specifically for modern arcade and home dance gaming. It focuses on precision timing, low input latency, and custom theme support.

Features:
- Highly optimized input polling system delivering low latency on modern dance pads
- Full support for In The Groove and Dance Dance Revolution simfiles, charts, and music
- Modernized Linux audio backends including PipeWire, ALSA, and PulseAudio
- Broad theme support with real-time score tracking, timing statistics, and modifiers
- Robust USB dance pad profile saving and online leaderboard integrations
